title: 十三张失利结算弹层动画关键帧

prompt: Create an exact 4-column by 4-row transparent sprite sheet of 16 sequential frames for the decorative opening of a Shisanshui loss-result popup. The same blank, wide rounded deep-emerald panel silhouette stays centered and the same size in every cell. Animate a calm ivory edge light that softly appears then settles, with a few dim teal sparks drifting down and disappearing. Frame progression: panel gently fades in, a subtle edge glint passes once, particles settle, final frames hold a stable blank panel. Keep the mood respectful and calm rather than punitive. Leave the entire central panel empty and transparent enough for live H5 text, buttons, scores and result details. Exact 4x4 equal cells, no overlap across cells. Premium game-specific emerald-and-gold style.
